projectDescription: An opinionated, modular ASP.NET Core framework that provides foundational infrastructure, cross-cutting concerns, application modules, startup templates, and UI themes for building enterprise .NET web applications.
keyFeatures: Module System with typed DependsOn dependency graph and lifecycle hooks (PreConfigureServices, ConfigureServices, PostConfigureServices, OnApplicationInitialization)
DDD Building Blocks: Entity, AggregateRoot, IRepository, DomainService, ApplicationService with full auditing hierarchies
Unit of Work (IUnitOfWork, IUnitOfWorkManager) with ambient UoW, transaction APIs, and database APIs
Entity Framework Core integration: AbpDbContext, EfCoreRepository, global data filters, change trackers
MongoDB integration: AbpMongoDbContext, MongoDbRepository, BSON serializers, client factory
Distributed Event Bus with Inbox/Outbox pattern, RabbitMQ/Kafka/Azure Service Bus providers
Background Jobs system with pluggable IBackgroundJobStore, Hangfire and Quartz integrations
Multi-Tenancy: TenantResolver, ICurrentTenant, contributor-based resolution, per-tenant connection strings
Authorization & Permissions: PermissionDefinitionManager, PermissionChecker, dynamic permission store, method-invocation interceptor
Distributed Caching (IDistributedCache<T>) and Hybrid Cache layer
BLOB Storing abstraction with BlobContainer, BlobProvider, Azure/AWS/database providers
Localization system with AbpStringLocalizerFactory, inherited resource types, external localization store
Virtual File System for embedding static resources across modules
HTTP Client Proxies (ClientProxyBase) for consuming remote ABP services
Conventional Controllers: auto-expose application services as REST API endpoints
Angular front-end packages (@abp/ng.core, @abp/ng.account, @abp/ng.identity, @abp/ng.oauth, etc.)
MVC npm packs for server-rendered UI (Bootstrap, jQuery, SignalR, DataTables bundled via ABP bundling system)
Pre-built application modules: Identity, Account, OpenIddict, TenantManagement, CmsKit, AuditLogging
ABP CLI with project creation, code generation, proxy generation, and build orchestration
Startup templates for app (Angular/MVC/Blazor), module, console, MAUI, and WPF
Text Templating (Scriban/Razor engines) for dynamic content generation
AI integration abstractions (Volo.Abp.AI, Volo.Abp.AI.Abstractions)
publicApiSurface: AbpModule (framework/src/Volo.Abp.Core) — base class for all modules
